shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖储液海绵加粉底涂抹带交代品类与妆效

把两款并置收口，引导按妆效取向选装下单

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, creamy ivory #F6E7D7 and soft rose-blush #EBC0BC fields for benefit and mechanism screens, deep berry-magenta #A21B52 reserved for the closing panel

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dewy base-makeup visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, creamy ivory #F6E7D7, soft rose-blush #EBC0BC and one berry-magenta accent #A21B52; warm high-key studio lighting from a large soft front key with bounce fill, low contrast, gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in deep charcoal #3B3033 with generous letterspacing; hairline rules and small solid dot markers in berry-magenta #A21B52 as the only icon language; glossy reflective acrylic surface with soft mirror bounce; stable slight 3/4 to high 45-degree product angles and consistent compact scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no shade numbers or sun-protection figures rendered anywhere
style.presentationRules: compact always shown open with the hinged lid back at a stable slight 3/4 to high 45-degree angle, puff kept as the only companion object, consistent compact scale across all screens
style.surfaceSystem: glossy reflective acrylic sheet #F3DAD3 for benefit screens, matte creamy board #F6E7D7 for mechanism screens, seamless matte paper #FFFFFF for packshots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in deep charcoal #3B3033 with generous letterspacing; source lettering stripped so every copy block stays an empty held-out zone
